title: Resilience at the Heart of Australia-Singapore Ties
gist: The 15th Singapore-Australia Joint Ministerial Committee in Adelaide produced a new Protocol on Economic Resilience and Essential Supplies, signalling that both governments now define national security to include access to essential goods, not just traditional defense.

themes.theme: Supply security folded into national security

insights.claim: Singapore and Australia signed a new Protocol on Economic Resilience and Essential Supplies as the centerpiece of the 15th Singapore-Australia Joint Ministerial Committee.
insights.speaker: Grant Wyeth
entities: Protocol on Economic Resilience and Essential Supplies
insights.so_what: Bilateral supply-guarantee pacts are becoming a policy instrument in Asia-Pacific; they create preferential trade lanes in food, fuel and medical goods that cut against pure spot-market pricing.
insights.quote: The centerpiece of the discussions was the signing of a new Protocol on Economic Resilience and Essential Supplies.

insights.claim: Australia and Singapore are redefining national security to cover the securing of essential goods needed to maintain services and living standards, rather than traditional defense alone.
insights.speaker: Grant Wyeth
insights.so_what: A widening security perimeter justifies state intervention in logistics, food and energy stockpiles — read it as structural support for domestic supply-chain and storage capex.
insights.quote: both countries are viewing their national security now not solely in terms of traditional defense, but in terms of securing essential goods

insights.claim: The Singapore-Australia Joint Ministerial Committee convenes every two years and deliberately spans the full spectrum of the relationship instead of a single policy area, with foreign affairs, defense and trade ministers from both countries attending this round in Adelaide.
insights.speaker: Grant Wyeth
insights.so_what: Cross-portfolio ministerial formats produce package deals rather than single-sector agreements — a template worth tracking for how middle powers bundle trade and defense concessions.
insights.locator: The SAJMC is held every two years
